title: Artemis - Better Biomes
description: A lightweight worldgen datapack designed to enhance the natural beauty of Minecraft without changing its core gameplay. Every change is crafted to stay true to vanilla, while being more vibrant, immersive and fresh.
body:
# Artemis - Better Biomes
_Created by Zackattack4100 (MC name) / MoisturePack (PMC / Modrinth name)_

Artemis 26.2 Planet Minecraft Link: [Artemis - Better Biomes 26.2 On Planet MInecraft](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/artemis-26-2-better-biomes/)

Artemis 26.1 Planet Minecraft Link: [Artemis - Better Biomes 26.1 On Planet MInecraft](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/artemis-better-biomes/)

## Artemis Highlights
- **Enhanced Biome Colors**
  - Every biome has been reworked with subtle but richer sky, fog, and lighting colors to create a more atmospheric and immersive world.
- **Major tree upgrade**
  - Nearly every naturally generating tree has been redesigned to be taller, fuller, and more realistic, while still fitting perfectly into Minecraft’s style, no more blocky and annoyingly short trees!
- **Cleaner Terrain Generation**
  - Rivers and mountain biomes generate more cleanly for a smoother, more natural look.
- **Immersive Audio**
  - Mountain and windswept biomes now feature ambient windy sounds, bringing highlands to life.

## Dimension Improvements
### Overworld
- More vibrant and dynamic biome visuals.
- Major upgrades to forests and wooded areas.
- Additionally, improved mangrove swamps to be much less laggy, and more traversable.
- Cleaner rivers and mountains.
- Ambient wind effects in mountain and windswept regions.

### Nether
- Enhanced biome color palettes for a more intense atmosphere.
- Improved Crimson and Warped “trees” with more distinct and interesting shapes.
- Soul Sand Valley slightly reworked for a more consistent and thematic terrain style.

### The End
- Subtle color enhancements across all End biomes for a more immersive atmosphere.
- Moody ambient sounds.

## Vanilla-Friendly
- No major terrain overhauls.
- No new blocks or items.
- No changes to core gameplay.

Perfect for players who want a fresh visual experience without sacrificing the classic Minecraft feel. Whether you're exploring, building, or just taking in the scenery, your world will feel new, fresh, and familiar!

**See the gallery tab for images of some of the changes made to a handful of biomes**

## How to Update
To update **Artemis** in the future, all you have to do is open your world's datapacks folder, then delete the folder called **Artemis** and then drag the new **Artemis** folder into the datapack folder, then your done!

Thank you for visiting and be sure to check back for future updates and bug fixes!
